entities.name: Kopala
entities.description: Introspective merfolk wizard of the River Heralds on Ixalan, youngest of the Nine Shapers, with high aspirations.

entities.name: Tishana
entities.description: Shaper who summoned Kopala to a tribal congress.

entities.name: Nine Shapers
entities.description: Group of merfolk Shapers, of which Kopala is the youngest.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: Merfolk band on Ixalan to which Kopala belongs.

entities.name: Great River
entities.description: River whose nine tributaries are fought over by merfolk bands.

entities.name: Matzalantli
entities.description: Site whose discovery preceded the tribal congress.

events.summary: After the discovery of Matzalantli, Tishana summons Kopala to a tribal congress to decide the plane's fate.
events.quote: he was summoned by Shaper Tishana to a tribal congress so that they can decide together the fate of the plane.

relations.quote: He is the youngest of the Nine Shapers.
